findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_meetings, search_transcripts, trading_post_catalog · Private data: list_markets, meeting, document_text, officer_lookup, legacy_formats, batch_conversion_offer · Public sink: trading_post_catalog, evidence_pack_submit, trading_post_ledger.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_meetings, search_transcripts, trading_post_catalog · Private data: list_markets, meeting, document_text, officer_lookup, legacy_formats, batch_conversion_offer · Public sink: trading_post_catalog, evidence_pack_submit, trading_post_ledger

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
